title.zh: 卷514 列傳三百一 土司傳三 雲南
title.en: Volume 514 Biographies 301: Native Chieftain Biographies 3: Yunnan
title.raw: 卷514 列傳三百一 土司傳三 雲南

sentences.zh: 雲南古滇國。

translations.literal: Yunnan was anciently the state of Dian.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity Yunnan was the realm of Dian.

sentences.zh: 自越巂蠻夷任貴自領太守，漢光武即授以印綬，不以內地官守例之。

translations.literal: From the time the Yuexi barbarian Ren Gui took the prefecture on his own authority, Emperor Guangwu of Han at once granted him seal and cord, not applying the precedent used for prefects and magistrates of the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Once Ren Gui, a tribal leader of Yuexi, had seized the prefecture for himself, Emperor Guangwu of the Han immediately invested him with seal and ribbon, treating him outside the usual rules for officials of the heartland.

sentences.zh: 若爨、若蒙，皆以本土大姓，就官累世，為一方長。

translations.literal: Such clans as Cuan and Meng were all great local surnames who took office generation after generation and became regional leaders.
translations.idiomatic: Families like the Cuan and the Meng were powerful local lineages that held office for generations and ruled their districts as chieftains.

sentences.zh: 元封梁王於滇，與大理之段分治。

translations.literal: Under the Yuan a Prince of Liang was enfeoffed in Dian, and he ruled jointly with the Duan of Dali.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan enfeoffed a Liang prince in Dian while the Duan of Dali held the other half of the country.

sentences.zh: 明破梁王，滅大理，就土官而統馭之，分宣慰使、宣撫使、安撫使、正副長官司、土府、土州以治之。

translations.literal: When the Ming destroyed the Liang prince and extinguished Dali, they governed through native officials, dividing administration among Pacification Commissioners, Pacification Superintendents, Pacification Envoys, principal and deputy native prefects, native prefectures, and native departments.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming overthrew the Liang house, destroyed Dali, and ruled through native chiefs, parceling out Pacification Commissioners, Pacification Superintendents, Pacification Envoys, chief and deputy native prefects, native prefectures, and native departments.

sentences.zh: 清順治十七年，平西王吳三桂定雲南，明永明王走緬甸，以沐府舊地封三桂，永鎮雲南。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, the Prince of Pingxi, Wu Sangui, secured Yunnan; the Yongli Emperor of Ming fled to Burma; the former territory of the Mu household was enfeoffed upon Sangui to hold Yunnan in perpetuity.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 17 (1660) Wu Sangui, Prince of Pingxi, took Yunnan; the Ming Yongli Emperor fled into Burma; and the old Mu domains were granted to Sangui to guard Yunnan forever.

sentences.zh: 康熙十四年，撤籓，三桂遂叛。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi the princedom was abolished, and Sangui thereupon rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 14 (1675) the fief was revoked and Sangui rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 三桂死，其孫世璠襲。

translations.literal: When Sangui died, his grandson Shifan succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: After Sangui died his grandson Shifan inherited the cause.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，克之，世璠自殺，雲南大定。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year they were taken; Shifan killed himself, and Yunnan was largely settled.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 21 (1682) the rebels were crushed; Shifan took his own life and Yunnan was brought to order.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，改土歸流之議起。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongzheng the proposal to replace native rule with regular administration arose.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yongzheng reign the policy of "replacing chiefs with magistrates" came to the fore.

sentences.zh: 四年夏，先革東川土目，即進圖烏蒙。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fourth year they first abolished the native headmen of Dongchuan and at once advanced plans against Wumeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Yongzheng 4 (1726) the Dongchuan native headmen were abolished first, and operations against Wumeng followed immediately.

sentences.zh: 時烏蒙土府祿萬鍾、鎮雄土府隴慶侯皆年少，兵權皆握于其叔祿鼎坤、隴聯星。

translations.literal: At that time Lu Wanzhong of the Wumeng native prefecture and Long Qinghou of the Zhenxiong native prefecture were both young; military power lay entirely with their uncles Lu Dingkun and Long Lianxing.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Wanzhong of Wumeng and Long Qinghou of Zhenxiong were both minors; real authority rested with their uncles Lu Dingkun and Long Lianxing.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰令總兵劉起元屯東川，招降祿鼎坤。

translations.literal: Ortai ordered Regional Commander Liu Qiyuan to encamp at Dongchuan and summon Lu Dingkun to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai stationed Regional Commander Liu Qiyuan at Dongchuan and called on Lu Dingkun to submit.

sentences.zh: 惟祿萬鍾制于漢奸，約鎮雄兵三千攻鼎坤于魯甸，鄂爾泰遣遊擊哈元生敗之；

translations.literal: Only Lu Wanzhong was controlled by a Han traitor; he arranged three thousand troops from Zhenxiong to attack Dingkun at Ludian, and Ortai sent Guerrilla Commander Ha Yuansheng to defeat them;
translations.idiomatic: Wanzhong, however, was dominated by a Han collaborator who persuaded Zhenxiong to send three thousand men against Dingkun at Ludian; Ortai dispatched Guerrilla Commander Ha Yuansheng and broke them.

sentences.zh: 又檄其相仇之阿底土兵共搗烏蒙，連破關隘，賊遂敗走鎮雄。

translations.literal: He also ordered the mutually hostile Adi native troops to strike Wumeng together; they broke pass after pass, and the rebels fled in defeat toward Zhenxiong.
translations.idiomatic: He then directed the feuding Adi native levies to join in an assault on Wumeng, storming one barrier after another until the rebels broke and ran toward Zhenxiong.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰復招降隴聯星，而鼎坤亦以兵三千攻鎮雄之脅，兩酋皆遁四川，於是兩土府旬日平。

translations.literal: Ortai again induced Long Lianxing to surrender, while Dingkun also led three thousand men to threaten Zhenxiong's flank; both chiefs fled into Sichuan, and the two native prefectures were pacified within ten days.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai won over Long Lianxing as well, while Dingkun marched three thousand men against Zhenxiong's rear; both chiefs escaped into Sichuan, and the two prefectures were settled within ten days.

sentences.zh: 以烏蒙設府，鎮雄設州，又設鎮于烏蒙，控制三屬，由四川改隸雲南，以一事權。

translations.literal: Wumeng was made a prefecture and Zhenxiong a department; a garrison was also established at Wumeng to control three subordinate districts; jurisdiction was transferred from Sichuan to Yunnan to unify command.
translations.idiomatic: Wumeng became a prefecture and Zhenxiong a department; a garrison was planted at Wumeng to oversee three dependencies; and the region was shifted from Sichuan to Yunnan so that authority would rest in one hand.

sentences.zh: 其東川法戛土目祿天祐、烏蒙米貼土目祿永孝，尚各據巢患邊。

translations.literal: The Faga native headman of Dongchuan, Lu Tianyou, and the Mitie native headman of Wumeng, Lu Yongxiao, still each held their lairs and troubled the border.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Tianyou, Faga headman of Dongchuan, and Lu Yongxiao, Mitie headman of Wumeng, still clung to their strongholds and harassed the frontier.

sentences.zh: 六年春，遣兵破擒法戛，又遣副將郭壽域以兵三百捕米貼賊，逃渡小金沙江，糾四川沙馬司及建昌、涼山各夷倮數千潛回，襲陷官兵。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year troops were sent to break and capture Faga; Deputy General Guo Shouyu was also sent with three hundred men to seize the Mitie bandits; they fled across the Lesser Jinsha River, rallied several thousand Yi and Lolo from Sichuan's Shama Circuit and from Jianchang and Liangshan, slipped back in secret, and overwhelmed the government troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Yongzheng 6 Faga was stormed and its chief taken; Deputy General Guo Shouyu led three hundred men against the Mitie rebels, who crossed the Lesser Jinsha, mustered thousands of tribal Yi and Nuosu from Shama in Sichuan and from Jianchang and Liangshan, crept back, and overwhelmed the detachment.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰遣總兵張耀祖、參將哈元生三路搜討。

translations.literal: Ortai dispatched Regional Commander Zhang Yaozu and Colonel Ha Yuansheng on three routes to search out and punish them.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai sent Regional Commander Zhang Yaozu and Colonel Ha Yuansheng on three columns to hunt them down.

sentences.zh: 詔四川建昌、永寧官兵聽鄂爾泰節制。

translations.literal: An edict placed the troops of Jianchang and Yongning in Sichuan under Ortai's command.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered the Jianchang and Yongning forces of Sichuan to obey Ortai.

sentences.zh: 於是自小金沙江外，沙馬、雷波、吞都、黃螂諸土司地，直抵建昌，袤千餘里，皆置營汛，形聯勢控，並擒雷波土司楊明義；

translations.literal: Thereupon from beyond the Lesser Jinsha, through the territories of the native chiefs of Shama, Leibo, Tundu, Huanglang, and others, straight to Jianchang—a stretch of more than a thousand li—all were garrisoned with linked posts controlling one another, and Leibo native chief Yang Mingyi was also captured;
translations.idiomatic: From beyond the Lesser Jinsha, across the domains of Shama, Leibo, Tundu, Huanglang, and other chiefs, all the way to Jianchang—over a thousand li—camps and posts were strung together in a chain of control, and Leibo chief Yang Mingyi was taken as well.

sentences.zh: 而哈元生回軍復敗阿盧土司之眾數千，屯田東川，歲收二萬餘石，課礦歲萬金，資兵餉。

translations.literal: Ha Yuansheng, returning from campaign, again defeated several thousand men of the Alu native chief; he opened military colonies in Dongchuan, harvesting more than twenty thousand piculs a year and levying ten thousand taels from mines yearly to fund the army.
translations.idiomatic: On his return Ha Yuansheng routed several thousand men of the Alu chief, opened military farms in Dongchuan yielding more than twenty thousand piculs a year, and drew ten thousand taels annually from mines to pay the troops.

sentences.zh: 軍甫定，祿鼎坤以功擢河南參將，怏怏失望。

translations.literal: The army had barely been settled when Lu Dingkun, promoted to colonel in Henan for his merit, was discontented and disappointed.
translations.idiomatic: Hardly had the army stood down when Lu Dingkun, promoted to Henan colonel for his service, grew resentful and disaffected.

sentences.zh: 其子祿萬福乞回魯甸治產，見總兵劉起元軍律不肅，陰會其舊部謀變。

translations.literal: His son Lu Wanfu begged to return to Ludian to manage his estates; seeing that Regional Commander Liu Qiyuan's discipline was lax, he secretly gathered his old followers to plot rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: His son Lu Wanfu asked leave to return to Ludian to tend his property; finding Regional Commander Liu Qiyuan's troops slack, he secretly rallied former adherents to revolt.

sentences.zh: 時烏蒙商民萬計，有險可扼，且賊止標弩，無大砲，而劉起元惟媮餒賄和，賊遂陷鎮城，盡戕兵民，遍煽東川、鎮雄及四川涼山蠻數萬叛。

translations.literal: At that time tens of thousands of merchants and commoners were in Wumeng; there were defiles that could be held, and the rebels had only poisoned bolts, no heavy cannon; yet Liu Qiyuan only neglected his duties, grew weary, took bribes, and made peace—and the rebels thereupon seized the prefectural city, slaughtered soldiers and civilians alike, and incited tens of thousands of tribesmen in Dongchuan, Zhenxiong, and the Liangshan barbarians of Sichuan to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Wumeng held tens of thousands of traders and townspeople and terrain that could be bottled up; the rebels carried only poisoned darts, no siege guns—yet Liu Qiyuan neglected duty, grew slack, took bribes, and bought peace. The rebels then took the prefectural seat, massacred troops and civilians, and stirred tens of thousands of tribesmen in Dongchuan, Zhenxiong, and Liangshan in Sichuan to rise.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰奏言：「臣用人僨事，請別簡大臣總督兩省，暫假臣提督，將兵討賊雪憤。

translations.literal: Ortai memorialized: "Your servant has failed in the men he employed; I beg that another great minister be chosen to govern both provinces, and that your servant be temporarily lent the post of provincial military commissioner to lead troops, punish the bandits, and wipe away this shame.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai reported: "I have misused men and brought disaster; please appoint another minister to govern both provinces and lend me the post of provincial military commissioner so I may lead troops to crush the rebels and redeem this failure."

sentences.zh: 」世宗慰留之。

translations.literal: " The Yongzheng Emperor comforted him and kept him in office.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzheng Emperor comforted him and kept him at his post.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰調官兵萬餘，土兵半之，三路進攻。

translations.literal: Ortai mobilized more than ten thousand government troops, with native levies equal to half that number, and attacked on three routes.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai mustered more than ten thousand regulars, half as many native auxiliaries, and advanced on three fronts.

sentences.zh: 先令總兵魏翥國率兵二千，七日馳抵東川，得不陷；

translations.literal: He first ordered Regional Commander Wei Zhuguo to lead two thousand men; in seven days they galloped to Dongchuan, and it was not lost;
translations.idiomatic: He sent Regional Commander Wei Zhuguo with two thousand men; they reached Dongchuan in seven days and saved the city.

sentences.zh: 而魏翥國旋為祿鼎明刺傷，乃以官祿代翥國。

translations.literal: but Wei Zhuguo was soon stabbed and wounded by Lu Dingming, and Guan Lu was then put in Zhuguo's place.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhuguo was soon stabbed and wounded by Lu Dingming, and Guan Lu replaced him in command.

sentences.zh: 烏蒙委總兵哈元生、副將徐成貴，鎮雄委參將韓勳。

translations.literal: For Wumeng he entrusted Regional Commander Ha Yuansheng and Deputy General Xu Chenggui; for Zhenxiong he entrusted Colonel Han Xun.
translations.idiomatic: Ha Yuansheng and Deputy General Xu Chenggui took Wumeng; Colonel Han Xun took Zhenxiong.

sentences.zh: 勳以兵四百扼奎鄉，敗賊四千，連破四寨。

translations.literal: Xun with four hundred men held Kuixiang, defeated four thousand rebels, and captured four stockades in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Han Xun held Kuixiang with four hundred men, routed four thousand rebels, and stormed four stockades in a row.

sentences.zh: 哈元生以千餘兵討烏蒙，先至得勝坡，遇賊二萬。

translations.literal: Ha Yuansheng with somewhat more than a thousand men campaigned against Wumeng; he first reached Desheng Slope and encountered twenty thousand rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Ha Yuansheng marched on Wumeng with a little over a thousand men, reached Desheng Slope first, and met twenty thousand rebels.

sentences.zh: 其黑寡、暮末二渠皆萬人敵。

translations.literal: Their two chieftains Heiguo and Mumo were each a match for ten thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Two of their leaders, Heiguo and Mumo, were each said to be worth ten thousand fighters.

sentences.zh: 黑寡持長槍，直犯元生，元生左格槍，右拔矢，應手殪之；

translations.literal: Heiguo bore a long spear and charged straight at Yuansheng; Yuansheng parried the spear with his left hand, drew an arrow with his right, and killed him on the spot;
translations.idiomatic: Heiguo charged with a long spear; Yuansheng parried left-handed, snatched an arrow right-handed, and dropped him where he stood.

sentences.zh: 又射殪暮末，即竿揭二首以進，賊奪氣。

translations.literal: He also shot and killed Mumo, then raised both heads on poles and advanced; the rebels lost heart.
translations.idiomatic: He shot Mumo as well, hoisted both heads on spears, and pressed forward; the enemy's spirit broke.

sentences.zh: 再戰再捷，進至倚那岡。

translations.literal: Victory followed victory in a second battle, and they advanced to Yina Gang.
translations.idiomatic: After another victory they pushed on to Yina Ridge.

sentences.zh: 賊數萬，連營十餘里。

translations.literal: The rebels numbered tens of thousands and camped in a line more than ten li long.
translations.idiomatic: Tens of thousands of rebels lay encamped along more than ten li.

sentences.zh: 我兵三千、土兵千，夜設伏賊營左右，而嚴陣以待。

translations.literal: Our troops were three thousand and native auxiliaries one thousand; by night they set ambushes on both flanks of the rebel camp while holding a strict battle line.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand regulars and a thousand native auxiliaries laid night ambushes on both flanks while forming a firm line.

sentences.zh: 黎明，賊數路來犯，不動。

translations.literal: At dawn the rebels attacked on several roads and did not move.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the rebels came on several roads; our line held firm.

sentences.zh: 將偪陣，砲起，大呼奮擊，山后伏兵左右夾攻，賊大潰，盡破其八十餘營，獲甲械輜重山積。

translations.literal: As they were about to close on the formation, cannon fired, a great shout went up, and a fierce charge was made; ambushers from behind the hill attacked on both sides; the rebels were utterly routed, more than eighty camps were all broken, and captured armor, weapons, and baggage piled like hills.
translations.idiomatic: When they neared our line the guns opened, our men shouted and charged, and the hill ambushers struck both flanks; the rebels collapsed, more than eighty camps were overrun, and arms and baggage heaped up like hills.

sentences.zh: 即日抵烏蒙，賊見元生旗，即反走，克三關，祿萬福兄弟、祿鼎坤均伏誅。

translations.literal: That same day they reached Wumeng; at sight of Yuansheng's banner the rebels turned and fled; three passes were taken; Lu Wanfu and his brothers and Lu Dingkun were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: That day they entered Wumeng; at Ha Yuansheng's standard the rebels fled; three passes fell; Lu Wanfu, his brothers, and Lu Dingkun were all put to death.

sentences.zh: 六年，鄂爾泰總督三省，其土州安於蕃、鎮沅土府刁澣，及赭樂長官土司、威遠州、廣南府各土目，先後劾黜。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Ortai became governor-general of three provinces; the native departments of Anyufan and the Zhenyuan native prefecture of Diao Huan, as well as the Zhele chief native prefect, the native headmen of Weiyuan Prefecture and Guangnan Prefecture, were impeached and removed one after another.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 6 Ortai governed three provinces; the native departments of Anyufan and Zhenyuan under Diao Huan, the Zhele chief prefecture, and the native headmen of Weiyuan and Guangnan were dismissed in turn.

sentences.zh: 惟刁氏之族舍土目煽糾威遠黑倮復反，戕知府劉洪度。

translations.literal: Only clansmen of the Diao who had been native headmen incited the Black Nuosu of Weiyuan to rebel again and killed Prefect Liu Hongdu.
translations.idiomatic: Only Diao clansmen who had lost their posts stirred the Black Nuosu of Weiyuan to rise again and murdered Prefect Liu Hongdu.

sentences.zh: 於是盡徙已革土司土目他省安置，並搜剿黨逆之威遠、新平諸倮，冒瘴突入，擒斬千計，而我將士亦患瘴死二百餘。

translations.literal: Thereupon all abolished native chiefs and headmen were relocated to other provinces for resettlement; they also searched out and suppressed the Nuosu partisans of Weiyuan and Xinping, braving malarial vapors to break in, capturing and beheading more than a thousand—while more than two hundred of our officers and soldiers also died of malaria.
translations.idiomatic: All deposed chiefs and headmen were then resettled in other provinces while troops hunted Nuosu allies in Weiyuan and Xinping, pushing through malarial country, killing more than a thousand—and losing more than two hundred of their own to fever.

sentences.zh: 又進剿瀾滄江內孟養、茶山土夷，即明王驥兵十二萬，大舉再征，諸蠻驚謂「自古漢兵所未至者」也。

translations.literal: They also advanced to suppress the native tribes of Mengyang and Chashan within the Lancang River—the same region where in the Ming Wang Ji had led an army of one hundred twenty thousand in a great second campaign, so that the tribes exclaimed that "since antiquity Han troops have never come here."
translations.idiomatic: Columns pushed up the Lancang against the Mengyang and Chashan tribes—the ground Wang Ji had invaded in the Ming with one hundred twenty thousand men—where the locals marveled that "Han armies have never come here since ancient times."

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰先檄車里土兵截諸江外，官兵各持斧鍬開路，焚柵湮溝，連破險隘，直抵孟養，據蠻坡通餉道；

translations.literal: Ortai first ordered Cheli native troops to block the far side of the river; government troops each carried axes and spades to open roads, burned stockades and filled ditches, broke dangerous passes in succession, and pressed straight to Mengyang, holding Mangpo to keep the supply route open;
translations.idiomatic: Ortai first blocked the far bank with Cheli native levies; regulars cut roads with axes and spades, burned palisades and filled trenches, stormed pass after pass to Mengyang, and held Mangpo to secure supplies.

sentences.zh: 其六茶山巢穴四十餘寨，乃用降夷鄉導，以賊攻賊，於是深入數千里，無險不搜。

translations.literal: its six Chashan nest areas with more than forty stockades then used surrendered tribes as guides and set tribes against tribes, so that they penetrated several thousand li and left no stronghold unsearched.
translations.idiomatic: Six Chashan strongholds with more than forty camps were taken with surrendered tribes as guides, tribe turned against tribe, until the army had swept several thousand li and left no refuge untouched.

sentences.zh: 惟江外歸車里土司，江內地全改流。

translations.literal: Only lands beyond the river were restored to the Cheli native chief; all territory within the river was wholly converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the river lands went back to the Cheli chief; everything within the river was placed under direct rule.

sentences.zh: 升普洱為府；

translations.literal: Pu'er was promoted to a prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Pu'er was raised to prefectural rank;

sentences.zh: 移沅江協副將駐之。

translations.literal: the deputy regional commander of Yuanjiang Command was moved to garrison there.
translations.idiomatic: and the Yuanjiang Command deputy regional commander was posted there.

sentences.zh: 于思茅、橄欖壩各設官戍兵，以扼蒙緬、老撾門戶。

translations.literal: Officials and garrison troops were established at Simao and Ganlanba to guard the gates to Burma and Laos.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates and garrisons were planted at Simao and Ganlanba to guard the approaches to Burma and Laos.

sentences.zh: 於是廣南府土同知、富州土知州，各原增歲糧二三千石，並捐建府、州城垣。

translations.literal: Thereupon the native associate prefect of Guangnan Prefecture and the native prefect of Fuzhou each voluntarily increased their annual grain tribute by two or three thousand piculs and donated funds to build prefectural and departmental walls.
translations.idiomatic: The native associate prefect of Guangnan and the native prefect of Fuzhou each added two or three thousand piculs to their annual grain payments and contributed to city walls.

sentences.zh: 孟連土司獻銀廠，怒江野夷輸皮幣，而老撾、景邁二國皆來貢象，緬甸震焉。

translations.literal: The Menglian native chief presented a silver mine; wild tribes of the Nu River offered pelts and cloth; and the states of Laos and Jingmai both sent tribute elephants—Burma was shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Menglian presented a silver mine; Nu River tribes brought furs and cloth; Laos and Jingmai sent tribute elephants—and Burma trembled.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十四年，遷孟拱土司於關外。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of Qianlong the Menggong native chief was moved beyond the pass.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 34 (1769) the Menggong native chief was relocated beyond the frontier pass.

sentences.zh: 緬甸事詳見緬甸傳。

translations.literal: Matters concerning Burma are given in detail in the Burma biography.
translations.idiomatic: Burma affairs are treated fully in the Burma biography.

sentences.zh: 煉象關土巡檢，居煉象關大街。

translations.idiomatic: The Lianxiang Pass native inspection post sat on the main street of Lianxiang Pass.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢李文秀歸附，仍授舊職。

translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 (1659) native inspector Li Wenxiu submitted and kept his old post.

sentences.zh: 傳至李東祚，乾隆五十年，改為從九品土官，世襲。

translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native inspector Li Qidou submitted and kept his post.

translations.literal: The native assistant prefect of Yunnan County was in the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan County native assistant prefect resided in the county seat.

translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 Yang Yulan's son Yue submitted and kept the hereditary native prefecture.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年，雲南縣改設流官知縣，其知縣改縣丞，世襲。

translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 (1667) Yunnan County received a regular magistrate; the native prefect became a hereditary county assistant prefect.

sentences.zh: 雲南縣土主簿，居土官村，離城十里。

translations.literal: The native registrar of Yunnan County lived at Tuguan Village, ten li from the city.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan County native registrar lived at Tuguan Village, ten li from the city.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土主簿張維歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native registrar Zhang Wei submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native registrar Zhang Wei submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 青索鼻土巡檢，在青索鼻。

translations.literal: The native inspection post of Qingsuobi was at Qingsuobi.
translations.idiomatic: The Qingsuobi native inspection post was at Qingsuobi.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢楊應鵬歸附，仍授舊職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native inspector Yang Yingpeng submitted and was still granted his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native inspector Yang Yingpeng submitted and retained his office.

translations.idiomatic: The line reached Yang Rongchang; in Qianlong 50 it became a hereditary ninth-rank native official.

sentences.zh: 浪穹縣土典史，在縣城。

translations.literal: The native archivist of Langqiong County was in the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Langqiong County native archivist was in the county seat.

translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native archivist Wang Fengzhou submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 蒲陀崆土巡檢，在蒲陀崆，距縣城十五里。

translations.literal: The native inspection post of Putuokong was at Putuokong, fifteen li from the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Putuokong native inspection post stood at Putuokong, fifteen li from the county seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢楊爭先歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native inspector Yang Zhengxian submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native inspector Yang Zhengxian submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 鳳羽鄉土巡檢，在鳳羽鄉，距縣城三十里。

translations.literal: The native inspection post of Fengyu Township was at Fengyu Township, thirty li from the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Fengyu Township native inspection post was at Fengyu, thirty li from the county seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢尹德明歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native inspector Yin Deming submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native inspector Yin Deming submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 上江嘴土巡檢，在上江嘴，距縣一百二十里。

translations.literal: The native inspection post of Shangjiangzui was at Shangjiangzui, one hundred twenty li from the county.
translations.idiomatic: The Shangjiangzui native inspection post lay at Shangjiangzui, one hundred twenty li from the county.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢楊康國歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native inspector Yang Kangguo submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native inspector Yang Kangguo submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 下江嘴土巡檢，在下江嘴，距縣九十里。

translations.literal: The native inspection post of Xiajiangzui was at Xiajiangzui, ninety li from the county.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiajiangzui native inspection post was at Xiajiangzui, ninety li from the county.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢何應福歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native inspector He Yingfu submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native inspector He Yingfu submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 箭杆場土巡檢，居箭杆場。

translations.literal: The native inspection post of Jiangan Field was at Jiangan Field.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangan Field native inspection post was at Jiangan Field.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢字題鳳歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native inspector Zi Tifeng submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native inspector Zi Tifeng submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 舊屬鄧川州，康熙二年，改隸雲龍州。

translations.literal: Formerly subordinate to Dengchuan Prefecture; in the second year of Kangxi it was transferred to Yunlong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It had belonged to Dengchuan Prefecture; in Kangxi 2 (1663) it was placed under Yunlong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二關長官司，在府東三百里。

translations.literal: The native prefect of the Twelve Passes was three hundred li east of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Twelve Passes native prefecture lay three hundred li east of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，長官司李恬森歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native prefect Li Tiansen submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native prefect Li Tiansen submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 老窩土千總，居老窩。

translations.literal: The native battalion commander of Laowo was at Laowo.
translations.idiomatic: The Laowo native battalion commander resided at Laowo.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土知州段德壽歸附，後裁。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native prefect Duan Deshou submitted and was later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native prefect Duan Deshou submitted; the post was later abolished.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十二年，德壽孫維精剿秤戛夷賊有功，十七年，授土千總世職。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Qianlong Deshou's grandson Weijing had merit in suppressing the Chengga barbarian bandits; in the seventeenth year he was granted the hereditary office of native battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 12 (1747) Deshou's grandson Weijing helped crush the Chengga rebels; in Qianlong 17 he received the hereditary battalion command.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，永北軍務，段克勳帶練擒賊，給五品頂戴。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang, during the Yongbei campaign, Duan Kexun led militia and captured bandits, and was given a fifth-rank official's cap button.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 1 (1821), in the Yongbei campaign, Duan Kexun led militia, captured rebels, and received a fifth-rank cap button.

sentences.zh: 六庫土千總，居六庫。

translations.literal: The native battalion commander of Liuku was at Liuku.
translations.idiomatic: The Liuku native battalion commander was at Liuku.

sentences.zh: 其先段復健，明土知州段保十七世孫。

translations.literal: His ancestor was Duan Fujian, seventeenth-generation descendant of the Ming native prefect Duan Bao.
translations.idiomatic: His forebear Duan Fujian was the seventeenth-generation descendant of the Ming native prefect Duan Bao.

sentences.zh: 清乾隆十二年，征秤戛夷賊有功，十七年，授土千總世職。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Qianlong of the Qing, for merit in the campaign against the Chengga barbarian bandits, in the seventeenth year he was granted the hereditary office of native battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 12, for service against the Chengga rebels, he received the hereditary battalion command in Qianlong 17.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，永北軍務，段履仁帶練擒賊，給五品頂戴。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang, during the Yongbei campaign, Duan Lüren led militia and captured bandits, and was given a fifth-rank official's cap button.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 1 Duan Lüren led militia, took rebels, and earned a fifth-rank cap button.

sentences.zh: 漕澗土把總，居漕澗。

translations.literal: The native platoon commander of Caojian was at Caojian.
translations.idiomatic: The Caojian native platoon commander was at Caojian.

sentences.zh: 清順治十八年，左文燦以堵禦功授土官長官司，子停襲。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, Zuo Wencan was granted the office of native chief prefect for merit in blocking the enemy; his son's succession was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 18 (1661) Zuo Wencan received a native chief prefecture for blocking the enemy; his son's succession lapsed.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十二年，文燦曾孫左世英隨征秤戛夷賊有功，授土把總，世襲。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Qianlong Wencan's great-grandson Zuo Shiying had merit in the campaign against the Chengga barbarian bandits and was granted the office of native platoon commander, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 12 Wencan's great-grandson Zuo Shiying served against the Chengga rebels and received the hereditary platoon command.

sentences.zh: 鄧川州土知州，清順治十六年，土知州阿尚夔歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: The native prefect of Dengchuan Prefecture: in the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native prefect A Shangkui submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: Dengchuan native prefect: in Shunzhi 16 A Shangkui submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 曾孫阿口遠，因縱賊殃民，雍正四年改流，安插江西。

translations.literal: His great-grandson A Kouyuan, for indulging bandits and harming the people, was converted to regular administration in the fourth year of Yongzheng and resettled in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandson A Kouyuan had sheltered bandits and harmed the people; in Yongzheng 4 he was removed from office and resettled in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 納樓茶甸長官司，在府西南一百八十里。

translations.literal: The native prefect of Nalou Chadian was one hundred eighty li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Nalou Chadian native prefecture lay one hundred eighty li southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，長官司普率歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native prefect Pu Shuai submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native prefect Pu Shuai submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，率附王祿叛，官兵討之，乞降，赦之，以子向化襲。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi, Shuai joined Wang Lu in rebellion; government troops campaigned against them; he begged to surrender and was pardoned, and his son Xianghua succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4 Shuai followed Wang Lu in revolt; when troops moved against them he surrendered, was pardoned, and his son Xianghua inherited.

sentences.zh: 納更山土巡檢，距府東南二百八十里。

translations.literal: The native inspection post of Nageng Mountain was two hundred eighty li southeast of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Nageng Mountain native inspection post stood two hundred eighty li southeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢龍天正歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native inspector Long Tianzheng submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native inspector Long Tianzheng submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 虧容甸長官司，在府西南一百四十里。

translations.literal: The native prefect of Kuirong Dian was one hundred forty li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Kuirong Dian native prefecture was one hundred forty li southwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，長官司孫大昌歸附，仍授副長官世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native prefect Sun Dachang submitted and was still granted the hereditary office of deputy native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native prefect Sun Dachang submitted and kept the hereditary deputy prefecture.

sentences.zh: 思陀鄉土舍，在府西南二百五十里。

translations.literal: The native headman of Situo Township was two hundred fifty li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Situo Township native headman resided two hundred fifty li southwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，長官司李秉忠歸附，仍授長官司、副長官世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native prefect Li Bingzhong submitted and was still granted the hereditary offices of native prefect and deputy native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native prefect Li Bingzhong submitted and kept both the prefectural and deputy prefectural lines.

sentences.zh: 後絕，改土舍。

translations.literal: Later the line died out and was changed to native headman.
translations.idiomatic: The line later died out and the post became a native headmanship.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十年，以李世元繼襲。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Kangxi, Li Shiyuan was allowed to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 20 Li Shiyuan was permitted to inherit.

sentences.zh: 溪處長官司副長官，在府西南三百一十五里。

translations.literal: The deputy native prefect of Xichu native prefecture was three hundred fifteen li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Xichu deputy native prefecture lay three hundred fifteen li southwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，長官司恩忠歸附，仍授副長官世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native prefect En Zhong submitted and was still granted the hereditary office of deputy native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native prefect En Zhong submitted and kept the hereditary deputy prefecture.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，附祿昌賢叛，伏誅，改土舍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi he joined Lu Changxian in rebellion, was executed, and the post was changed to native headman.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4 he followed Lu Changxian in revolt, was put to death, and the office became a headmanship.

sentences.zh: 瓦渣鄉長官司，在府西南二百四十里。

translations.literal: The native prefect of Wazha Township was two hundred forty li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Wazha Township native prefecture was two hundred forty li southwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，錢覺耀歸附，仍授副長官世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, Qian Jueyao submitted and was still granted the hereditary office of deputy native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 Qian Jueyao submitted and kept the hereditary deputy prefecture.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，通王祿叛，官兵擒斬之，職除，改土舍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi he communicated with Wang Lu in rebellion; government troops captured and beheaded him; the office was abolished and changed to native headman.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4 he colluded with Wang Lu; troops captured and executed him; the post was abolished and made a headmanship.

sentences.zh: 左能寨長官司，在府西南二百三十里。

translations.literal: The native prefect of Zuoneng Stockade was two hundred thirty li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Zuoneng Stockade native prefecture lay two hundred thirty li southwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，吳應科歸附，以非滇志所載，下臨安府查核，稽其譜系，蓋應科為明蚌頗十一世孫，因改土舍，准襲。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, Wu Yingke submitted; because he was not recorded in the Yunnan gazetteer, the case was referred to Lin'an Prefecture for verification; tracing his genealogy, it was found that Yingke was an eleventh-generation descendant of the Ming Bangpo, so the post was changed to native headman with permission to inherit.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 Wu Yingke submitted; absent from the Yunnan gazetteer, his claim went to Lin'an for review; genealogy showed him an eleventh-generation descendant of the Ming chief Bangpo, so he received a permitted hereditary headmanship.

sentences.zh: 落恐甸長官司，在府西南二百里。

translations.literal: The native prefect of Luokong Dian was two hundred li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Luokong Dian native prefecture was two hundred li southwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，明授副長官司陳玉歸附，因號紙無存，給便委土舍，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, Chen Yu, whom the Ming had appointed deputy native prefect, submitted; because his patent was lost, a provisional commission as native headman was issued, with hereditary succession still allowed.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 Chen Yu, Ming-appointed deputy prefect, submitted; his patent was missing, so he received a provisional headmanship with hereditary right preserved.

sentences.zh: 阿邦鄉土舍，在府東南二百一十里。

translations.literal: The native headman of Abang Township was two hundred ten li southeast of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Abang Township native headman resided two hundred ten li southeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 明授土守備。

translations.literal: In the Ming he had been granted the office of native garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming he held the rank of native garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土守備陶順祖歸附，守職如故。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native garrison commander Tao Shunzu submitted and kept his office as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native garrison commander Tao Shunzu submitted and retained his post.

sentences.zh: 旋議土司不宜加武職，改土舍。

translations.literal: Soon it was decided that native chiefs should not bear military titles, and the post was changed to native headman.
translations.idiomatic: Officials soon ruled that chiefs should not hold military rank, and the office became a headmanship.

sentences.zh: 慢車鄉土舍，在府西南一百四十里。

translations.literal: The native headman of Manche Township was one hundred forty li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Manche Township native headman lay one hundred forty li southwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清順治間，元江土夷亂，漫車土目刀岡隨官軍協剿，授土舍世職。

translations.literal: During Shunzhi, when the native tribes of Yuanjiang rebelled, the Manche native headman Dao Gang followed government troops in joint suppression and was granted the hereditary office of native headman.
translations.idiomatic: During Shunzhi, amid Yuanjiang tribal unrest, headman Dao Gang aided government troops and received a hereditary headmanship.

sentences.zh: 稿吾卡土把總，在府東南二百八十里。

translations.literal: The native platoon commander of Gaowuka was two hundred eighty li southeast of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Gaowuka native platoon commander was two hundred eighty li southeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清雍正間，納更土目龍在渭隨征元普逆夷有功，給土把總職銜。

translations.literal: During Yongzheng, Nageng native headman Long Zaiwei had merit in campaigning against the Yuan-Pu rebels and was given the title of native platoon commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongzheng era Nageng headman Long Zaiwei earned merit against Yuan-Pu rebels and received the platoon command.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二十二年，江外夷匪滋事，龍定國父子陣亡，奏准世襲土把總。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Jiaqing, when tribal bandits beyond the river made trouble, Long Dingguo and his son died in battle; memorial approval was given for hereditary native platoon commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 22, when tribes beyond the river rose, Long Dingguo and his son fell in battle; the throne approved a hereditary platoon command.

sentences.zh: 十五猛，縱橫四百餘里。

translations.literal: The Fifteen Meng stretched over more than four hundred li in every direction.
translations.idiomatic: The Fifteen Meng covered more than four hundred li across.

sentences.zh: 明初為沐氏勳莊。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Ming they were a merit estate of the Mu clan.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Ming they formed part of the Mu family's reward lands.

sentences.zh: 清順治十七年，吳三桂請並雲南荒田給與籓下壯丁耕種。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, Wu Sangui requested that Yunnan's waste land be combined and given to his fief's strong youths to cultivate.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 17 Wu Sangui asked that Yunnan's abandoned fields be granted his fiefsmen to farm.

sentences.zh: 康熙七年，奏旨圈撥。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kangxi an imperial rescript ordered their allocation by enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 7 the throne ordered them surveyed and allotted.

sentences.zh: 叛後，變價歸建水徵收。

translations.literal: After the rebellion they were sold off and their proceeds collected through Jianshui.
translations.idiomatic: After the revolt they were sold and the revenue routed through Jianshui.

sentences.zh: 猛各設一掌寨，督辦錢糧。

translations.literal: Each Meng had a headman installed to supervise grain payments.
translations.idiomatic: Each district received a headman to oversee tax grain.

sentences.zh: 管有猛喇、猛丁、猛梭、猛賴、猛蚌、茨桶壩、五畝、五邦、者米、猛弄、馬龍、瓦遮、鬥岩、阿土、水塘十五寨。

translations.literal: They governed fifteen stockades: Mengla, Mengding, Mengsuo, Menglai, Mengbang, Citongba, Wumu, Wubang, Zhemi, Mengnong, Malong, Wazhe, Douyan, Atu, and Shuitang.
translations.idiomatic: They comprised fifteen stockades: Mengla, Mengding, Mengsuo, Menglai, Mengbang, Citongba, Wumu, Wubang, Zhemi, Mengnong, Malong, Wazhe, Douyan, Atu, and Shuitang.

sentences.zh: 教化三部長官副長官。

translations.literal: The deputy native prefects of the three departments of Jiaohua.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiaohua Three Departments deputy native prefects.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，副長官龍升歸附，仍以張長壽為名，許之，授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, deputy native prefect Long Sheng submitted; he still used the name Zhang Changshou, which was allowed, and he was granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 deputy prefect Long Sheng submitted under the name Zhang Changshou, which was accepted, and he kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，附王祿叛，誅之，以其地為開化府，設流官。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi he joined Wang Lu in rebellion and was executed; his territory became Kaihua Prefecture with regular officials.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4 he followed Wang Lu, was executed, and his lands became Kaihua Prefecture under regular magistrates.

sentences.zh: 王弄山長官司副長官。

translations.literal: The deputy native prefect of Wangnong Mountain native prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Wangnong Mountain deputy native prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，副長官王朔歸附，授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, deputy native prefect Wang Shuo submitted and was granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 deputy prefect Wang Shuo submitted and received the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，朔與祿昌賢叛，官兵討之，朔自焚死，以其地屬開化府。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi Shuo joined Lu Changxian in rebellion; government troops campaigned against them; Shuo burned himself to death, and his territory was placed under Kaihua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4 Shuo rebelled with Lu Changxian; when troops closed in he burned himself, and his lands went to Kaihua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 阿迷州土知州，舊有土目李阿側。

translations.literal: The native prefect of Ami Prefecture formerly had a native headman Li Ace.
translations.idiomatic: Ami Prefecture's native prefecture had once included headman Li Ace.

sentences.zh: 清康熙四年，從討王朔有功，授土知州世職。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi of the Qing, for merit in campaigning against Wang Shuo, he was granted the hereditary office of native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4, for service against Wang Shuo, he received the hereditary native prefecture.

sentences.zh: 傳至李純，濫派橫征，為倮夷所控。

translations.literal: The line passed to Li Chun, who levied exactions at will and was controlled by the Lolo tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Li Chun, who taxed arbitrarily until the tribal Yi held him in check.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年，籍其產，安置江西，改流。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng his property was registered, he was resettled in Jiangxi, and the post was converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 4 his estates were seized, he was sent to Jiangxi, and the district was placed under regular rule.

sentences.zh: 寧州土知州，清順治十六年，祿昌賢歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: The native prefect of Ning Prefecture: in the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, Lu Changxian submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: Ningzhou native prefect: in Shunzhi 16 Lu Changxian submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 十七年，降州同。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was reduced to prefectural sub-prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 17 he was demoted to prefectural sub-prefect.

sentences.zh: 明年，以舉首梅道人等謀逆，復原職。

translations.literal: The next year, for exposing the plot of Mei Daoren and others to rebel, his former office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, for revealing Mei Daoren's conspiracy, his old rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，以叛伏誅。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi he was executed for rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4 he was executed for rebellion.

sentences.zh: 寧州土州判。

translations.literal: The native sub-prefect of Ning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Ningzhou native sub-prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清康熙十九年，滇有李者祿歸附，准世襲州判。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Kangxi of the Qing, when Yunnan was recovered, Li Zhelu submitted and was permitted hereditary sub-prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 19, after Yunnan was recovered, Li Zhelu submitted and received a hereditary sub-prefecture.

sentences.zh: 後絕，停襲。

translations.literal: Later the line died out and succession was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: The line later ended and inheritance lapsed.

sentences.zh: 嶍峨縣土知縣。

translations.literal: The native magistrate of Xi'e Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Xi'e native magistracy.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，祿益歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, Lu Yi submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 Lu Yi submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，與祿昌賢等叛改流。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi he joined Lu Changxian and others in rebellion and was converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4 he rebelled with Lu Changxian and the office was abolished for regular rule.

sentences.zh: 嶍峨縣土主簿。

translations.literal: The native registrar of Xi'e Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Xi'e native registrarship.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，王揚祖歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, Wang Yangzu submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 Wang Yangzu submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，與祿昌賢等叛，伏誅，職除。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi he joined Lu Changxian and others in rebellion, was executed, and the office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4 he followed Lu Changxian, was executed, and the post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 蒙自縣土縣丞。

translations.literal: The native assistant prefect of Mengzi County.
translations.idiomatic: The Mengzi County native assistant prefecture.

sentences.zh: 土知縣陸氏被黜，其土舍寧州祿重據土官村，溺於酒色，不能馭下。

translations.literal: The Lu family's native magistrate was dismissed; their native headman, Ningzhou's Lu Chong, held Tuguan Village, drowned in wine and women, and could not control his subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: The Lu native magistrate was removed; headman Lu Chong of Ningzhou held Tuguan Village, drowned in drink and women, and lost control of his men.

sentences.zh: 其目把李輔舜等叛歸沙源，源以兵乘之，遂破有土官村。

translations.literal: His subordinate headmen Li Fushun and others rebelled and went over to Sha Yuan; Yuan brought troops against them and broke Tuguan Village.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate headmen Li Fushun and others defected to Sha Yuan, who stormed in and took Tuguan Village.

sentences.zh: 沙定洲踞會城，令李輔舜子日芳竊據蒙自。

translations.literal: Sha Dingzhou seized the provincial city and had Li Fushun's son Rifang seize Mengzi.
translations.idiomatic: Sha Dingzhou held the provincial capital and set Li Fushun's son Rifang over Mengzi.

sentences.zh: 定洲敗，日芳遂家於蒙。

translations.literal: When Dingzhou was defeated, Rifang made his home in Meng.
translations.idiomatic: After Dingzhou's fall, Rifang settled in Mengzi.

sentences.zh: 清康熙四年，日芳弟日森子世籓、世屏附寧州祿昌賢叛，總兵閻鎮破之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi of the Qing, Rifang's younger brother Risun's sons Shifan and Shiping joined Ningzhou's Lu Changxian in rebellion; Regional Commander Yan Zhen defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4 Risun's sons Shifan and Shiping joined Lu Changxian of Ningzhou; Regional Commander Yan Zhen crushed them.

sentences.zh: 世籓遁，追斬之；

translations.literal: Shifan fled and was pursued and beheaded;
translations.idiomatic: Shifan escaped but was hunted down and killed;

sentences.zh: 世屏出降，免死，充大理軍。

translations.literal: Shiping came out and surrendered, was spared death, and was made to serve in the Dali army.
translations.idiomatic: Shiping surrendered, was spared, and was enrolled in the Dali garrison.

sentences.zh: 後吳三桂反，給世屏偽總兵劄。

translations.literal: Later, when Wu Sangui rebelled, Shiping was given a false commission as regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Sangui rebelled he gave Shiping a forged regional commander's patent.

sentences.zh: 大師復滇，世屏持劄歸附，授蒙自縣土縣丞職，不准世襲。

translations.literal: When the great army recovered Yunnan, Shiping presented his patent and submitted; he was granted the office of native assistant prefect of Mengzi County, without hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: When imperial forces retook Yunnan, Shiping submitted his patent and received the Mengzi assistant prefecture without inheritance.

sentences.zh: 楚雄縣土縣丞。

translations.literal: The native assistant prefect of Chuxiong County.
translations.idiomatic: The Chuxiong County native assistant prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土縣丞楊春盛歸附，仍授舊職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native assistant prefect Yang Chunsheng submitted and was still granted his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 assistant prefect Yang Chunsheng submitted and kept his post.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十年，改為正八品土官，世襲。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year of Qianlong it was changed to an eighth-rank native official, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 50 it became a hereditary eighth-rank native official.

sentences.zh: 鎮南州土州同，居本城。

translations.literal: The native sub-prefect of Zhennan Prefecture lived in the main city.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhennan native sub-prefecture was in the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土州同段光贊歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native sub-prefect Duan Guangzan submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 sub-prefect Duan Guangzan submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 鎮南州土州判，居鎮南州城東北。

translations.literal: The native sub-prefect of Zhennan Prefecture lived northeast of Zhennan Prefecture city.
translations.idiomatic: The second Zhennan native sub-prefecture lay northeast of the city.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土州判陳昌虞歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native sub-prefect Chen Changyu submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 sub-prefect Chen Changyu submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 阿雄關土巡檢，居鎮南州屬。

translations.literal: The native inspection post of Axiong Pass was in the jurisdiction of Zhennan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Axiong Pass native inspection post belonged to Zhennan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢者光祖歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native inspector Zhe Guangzu submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native inspector Zhe Guangzu submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 鎮南關土巡檢。

translations.literal: The native inspection post of Zhennan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhennan Pass native inspection post.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢楊繼祖歸附，仍授舊職，傳至楊文輝，乾隆五十年，改為從九品土官，世襲。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native inspector Yang Jizu submitted and was still granted his former office; the line passed to Yang Wenhui; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong it was changed to a ninth-rank native official, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 inspector Yang Jizu submitted and kept his post; the line reached Yang Wenhui; in Qianlong 50 it became a hereditary ninth-rank native official.

sentences.zh: 姚州土州同，居姚州西界彌興官莊。

translations.literal: The native sub-prefect of Yao Prefecture lived at the Mixing official estate on Yao Prefecture's western border.
translations.idiomatic: The Yao Prefecture native sub-prefecture was at the Mixing official estate on the western border.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土州同高顯錫歸附，仍授舊職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native sub-prefect Gao Xianxi submitted and was still granted his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 sub-prefect Gao Xianxi submitted and kept his post.

sentences.zh: 傳至高配忝，乾隆五十年，改為從六品土官，世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Gao Peitian; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong it was changed to a sixth-rank native official, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Gao Peitian; in Qianlong 50 it became a hereditary sixth-rank native official.

sentences.zh: 回磴關土巡檢，居回磴關。

translations.literal: The native inspection post of Huideng Pass was at Huideng Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The Huideng Pass native inspection post stood at Huideng Pass.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢楊忠藎歸附，仍授舊職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native inspector Yang Zhongyi submitted and was still granted his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 inspector Yang Zhongyi submitted and kept his post.

sentences.zh: 傳至楊怡，乾隆五十年，改為從九品土官，世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Yang Yi; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong it was changed to a ninth-rank native official, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Yang Yi; in Qianlong 50 it became a hereditary ninth-rank native official.

sentences.zh: 沙矣舊土巡檢。

translations.literal: The native inspection post of Shayi Old Station.
translations.idiomatic: The Shayi Old Station native inspection post.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢蘇鑒歸附，仍授舊職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native inspector Su Jian submitted and was still granted his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 inspector Su Jian submitted and kept his post.

sentences.zh: 傳至蘇敬，乾隆五十年，改為從九品土官，世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Su Jing; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong it was changed to a ninth-rank native official, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Su Jing; in Qianlong 50 it became a hereditary ninth-rank native official.

sentences.zh: 定遠縣土主簿，居本城。

translations.literal: The native registrar of Dingyuan County lived in the main city.
translations.idiomatic: The Dingyuan County native registrar lived in the county seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土主簿李世卿歸附，仍授舊職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native registrar Li Shiqing submitted and was still granted his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 registrar Li Shiqing submitted and kept his post.

sentences.zh: 傳至李毓英，乾隆五十年，改為正九品土官，世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Li Yuying; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong it was changed to a ninth-rank native official, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Li Yuying; in Qianlong 50 it became a hereditary ninth-rank native official.

sentences.zh: 姚安府土同知。

translations.literal: The native associate prefect of Yao'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Yao'an Prefecture native associate prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土同知高奣映歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native associate prefect Gao Angying submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 associate prefect Gao Angying submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 傳至李厚德，雍正三年，以不法革職，安置江南。

translations.literal: The line passed to Gao Houde; in the third year of Yongzheng he was dismissed for misconduct and resettled in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Gao Houde; in Yongzheng 3 he was removed for misconduct and sent to Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 新興州土州判，居州南研和邑。

translations.literal: The native sub-prefect of Xinxing Prefecture lived at Yanhe township south of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Xinxing native sub-prefecture was at Yanhe, south of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清康熙十九年，復滇，土人王鳳授偽遊擊，迎至廣西路投誠；

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Kangxi of the Qing, when Yunnan was recovered, the native Wang Fengshou held a false guerrilla commission and was escorted to Guangxi to submit;
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 19, when Yunnan was recovered, local leader Wang Fengshou bore a rebel guerrilla patent and was brought to Guangxi to surrender;

sentences.zh: 隨征石門檻、馬別河、黃草壩皆有功，授土州判世職。

translations.literal: He had merit in campaigning at Shimenjian, Mabie River, and Huangcaoba, and was granted the hereditary office of native sub-prefect.
translations.idiomatic: He served at Shimenjian, the Mabie River, and Huangcaoba and received the hereditary native sub-prefecture.

sentences.zh: 河陽縣安插土官。

translations.literal: Resettled native officials of Heyang County.
translations.idiomatic: Native officials resettled in Heyang County.

sentences.zh: 清順治初，土官刀韜歸附，止給劄，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi of the Qing, native official Dao Tao submitted; only a commission was given, with hereditary succession still permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi native official Dao Tao submitted and received a commission with hereditary right.

sentences.zh: 沿至刀廷俊，裁革。

translations.literal: Down to Dao Tingjun the office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The line continued to Dao Tingjun, when the post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 鐵爐關土巡檢。

translations.literal: The native inspection post of Tielu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The Tielu Pass native inspection post.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢王先榮歸附，授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native inspector Wang Xianrong submitted and was granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native inspector Wang Xianrong submitted and received the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，同王耀祖叛，削除。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi he joined Wang Yaozu in rebellion and was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4 he rebelled with Wang Yaozu and the office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 廣南府土同知。

translations.literal: The native associate prefect of Guangnan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangnan Prefecture native associate prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，儂鵬歸附，授同知世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, Nong Peng submitted and was granted the hereditary office of associate prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 Nong Peng submitted and received the hereditary associate prefecture.

sentences.zh: 傳至儂毓榮，乾隆三十一年，從征普洱、緬甸。

translations.literal: The line passed to Nong Yurong; in the thirty-first year of Qianlong he followed the campaign against Pu'er and Burma.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Nong Yurong, who campaigned in Pu'er and Burma in Qianlong 31.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，頒給土同知關防。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year the official seal of native associate prefect was issued.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 37 he received the associate prefect's official seal.

sentences.zh: 子世昌，嘉慶二年從征貴州仲苗，加銜一等，賞戴花翎，世襲。

translations.literal: His son Shichang, in the second year of Jiaqing, followed the campaign against the Zhong Miao of Guizhou; an additional first-rank title was added, peacock feathers were bestowed, and the office was hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shichang served against the Guizhou Zhong Miao in Jiaqing 2, gained a first-rank title and peacock feathers, and inherited the post.

sentences.zh: 富州土知州，在府東二百六十五里。

translations.literal: The native prefect of Fu Prefecture was two hundred sixty-five li east of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Fu Prefecture native prefecture lay two hundred sixty-five li east of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土知州沈昆巘歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native prefect Shen Kunxi submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native prefect Shen Kunxi submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 康熙九年，頒給州印。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Kangxi the prefectural seal was issued.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 9 the prefectural seal was granted.

sentences.zh: 後以罪黜，傳至沈肇乾。

translations.literal: Later he was dismissed for crime; the line passed to Shen Zhaoqian.
translations.idiomatic: He was later dismissed for misconduct; the line reached Shen Zhaoqian.

sentences.zh: 雍正八年，肇乾復以罪黜。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yongzheng, Zhaoqian was again dismissed for crime.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 8 Zhaoqian was dismissed again for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 大猛麻土巡檢。

translations.literal: The native inspection post of Damengma.
translations.idiomatic: The Damengma native inspection post.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢俸新命歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, native inspector Feng Xinming submitted and was still granted the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 native inspector Feng Xinming submitted and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 猛猛土巡檢，明末奔竄，失其印信號紙，未能請襲。

translations.literal: The native inspection post of Mengmeng: at the end of the Ming they fled in disorder and lost their seal and patent, and could not request succession.
translations.idiomatic: The Mengmeng inspection post: in the late Ming the holders fled and lost seal and patent, so succession lapsed.

sentences.zh: 傳子紫芝，清康熙五十四年歸附，貢象，仍授世職，頒給鈐記。

translations.literal: His son Zizhi, in the fifty-fourth year of Kangxi of the Qing, submitted, presented tribute elephants, and was still granted the hereditary office; an official seal was issued.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zizhi submitted in Kangxi 54, sent tribute elephants, recovered the hereditary post, and received an official seal.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十九年，改屬順寧府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Qianlong it was transferred to Shunning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 29 jurisdiction passed to Shunning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 孟連宣撫司，在順甯府邊外南境，舊隸於永昌府。

translations.literal: The Pacification Superintendency of Menglian was on the southern frontier beyond Shunning Prefecture and was formerly subordinate to Yongchang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Menglian Pacification Superintendency lay on Shunning's southern frontier beyond the pass and had belonged to Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 清康熙四十八年，刁派鼎貢象，歸附，授宣撫司世職。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year of Kangxi of the Qing, Diao Paiding presented tribute elephants, submitted, and was granted the hereditary office of Pacification Superintendency.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 48 Diao Paiding sent tribute elephants, submitted, and received the hereditary pacification superintendency.

sentences.zh: 派鼎死，子刁派春年幼，叔祖刁派烈撫孤。

translations.literal: When Paiding died, his son Diao Paichun was young, and his grand-uncle Diao Pailie raised the orphan.
translations.idiomatic: Paiding died leaving young Paichun; grand-uncle Pailie raised the boy.

sentences.zh: 有刁派猷謀殺派烈，奪印爭職，安插省城，另給宣撫司鈐記便委。

translations.literal: Diao Paiyou plotted to kill Pailie, seize the seal, and fight for the office; he was resettled in the provincial capital and a provisional seal of Pacification Superintendency was separately issued.
translations.idiomatic: Paiyou plotted to murder Pailie and seize the seal; he was sent to the capital and given a provisional pacification seal.

sentences.zh: 傳至刁派新，因地處極邊，界連外域，定為經制宣撫司，頒給印信號紙。

translations.literal: The line passed to Diao Paixin; because the territory lay on the extreme frontier bordering foreign lands, it was fixed as a regular Pacification Superintendency and an official seal and patent were issued.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Paixin; as the domain bordered foreign territory it was made a regular pacification superintendency with full seal and patent.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十九年，改隸順寧府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Qianlong it was transferred to Shunning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 29 it was placed under Shunning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 猛緬長官司，清乾隆十一年，歸流，改其地為緬寧，設流官通判駐其地。

translations.literal: The native prefect of Mengmian: in the eleventh year of Qianlong it was converted to regular administration; its territory became Mianning, and a regular sub-prefect was stationed there.
translations.idiomatic: Mengmian native prefecture: in Qianlong 11 it was abolished for regular rule; the district became Mianning with a regular sub-prefect.

sentences.zh: 平彝縣土縣丞，居平彝縣竹園村。

translations.literal: The native assistant prefect of Pingyi County lived at Zhuyuan Village in Pingyi County.
translations.idiomatic: The Pingyi County native assistant prefect resided at Zhuyuan Village.

sentences.zh: 清順治初，土縣丞龍闊歸附，仍舊世襲。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi of the Qing, native assistant prefect Long Kuo submitted and still inherited as before.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi assistant prefect Long Kuo submitted and kept the hereditary post.
